title: Slurm Backfill：保留工作起點與空檔利用
titleEn: Slurm backfill: protected starts and idle-window use
subcategoryTitle: 排程與可重現軟體堆疊
summary: 以合成資料重建「Slurm Backfill：保留工作起點與空檔利用」，能分離架構事實、模型假設與驗收證據。完成：交付四泳道時間圖、node-minute 帳本與超時反例。
summaryEn: Reconstruct Slurm backfill: protected starts and idle-window use with synthetic data; distinguish architecture facts, model assumptions and acceptance evidence. Complete: Deliver four-lane timelines, node-minute ledgers and an overrun counterexample.
scope: 本課採用原創合成工作負載或事件資料，在紙面、試算表與離線模型中實作。來源用於查證具名案例；數值、擾動與驗收門檻是教學假設，不是實機效能或正式環境變更規格。實驗限自己的或明確授權的隔離環境，交付可重算的證據紀錄。
scopeEn: Use original synthetic workloads or event data in paper, spreadsheet, and offline-model investigations. References establish named case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and limits are teaching assumptions, not measured machine performance or production change specifications. Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.

quiz.questionEn: Locate the reservation boundary: Which is case context to establish from the named official source, rather than a fault hypothesis or disposition?
options: 若短工作聲明時間過短卻實際超時，可能侵入預留；要分開申請 walltime 與合成實際時間。
接受填補前先驗證不延誤和資源相容；利用率上升不能凌駕受保護起點。
Slurm backfill 可讓合適短工作使用預留開始時間前的資源；本課以節點時間圖判斷是否延誤優先工作。
optionsEn: An underestimated short-job duration can intrude on the reservation; distinguish requested walltime from modeled actual duration.
Validate no delay and resource compatibility before acceptance; higher utilization does not override the protected start.
Slurm backfill can fit short work before protected starts; node-time diagrams test whether priority work is delayed.
quiz.explanation: 本步要識別「案例與來源邊界」。Slurm backfill 可讓合適短工作使用預留開始時間前的資源；本課以節點時間圖判斷是否延誤優先工作。 與本階段判準一起判讀：優先起點固定 30 min；不能為了利用率擅自移動。
quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies case and source boundary. Slurm backfill can fit short work before protected starts; node-time diagrams test whether priority work is delayed. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: The protected start is fixed at 30 min and is not moved to improve utilization.

steps.instruction:
